title: Design Review Loop QA
eyebrow: QA · #592: reviewer, acceptance run, parked questions and deviations ledger

short.lead: The design review loop is built and its acceptance run passes all nine criteria on your Windows PC (round 2). You check that the results read right, then reply with a pass or what failed.
short.hint: Tap a row to see what was checked and how.
items: All nine criteria pass on your PC

Round 2 ran docs/qa/design-review-loop/run_acceptance.py on your Windows machine, one output file per search text under round-2/. Every criterion C1 to C9 shows PASS and STATUS is pass. Round 1 (6 pass, 3 fail) is recorded beside it in round-1.md.

Your first PC run failed everything: the design_loop part crashed because a test faked gh with a shell script Windows cannot run, and a plan page saved with Windows line endings looked changed after review. Both are fixed and covered by the passing run.
scripts/acceptance.py stamp wrote acceptance-stamp.json after the round passed, and acceptance.py check reports it current. ledger.py check reports 9 criteria, 2 rounds, valid.
Open docs/qa/design-review-loop/round-2.md and read the nine PASS lines. Open one output file, such as round-2/c6-1.txt, and confirm it ends with the passing checks for the combined approval.

changes: The close-facts tests no longer need a shell script.
The tests faked gh with a #!/bin/sh file, which Windows cannot run, so design_loop crashed with no checks reported.
A Python stand-in replaces gh in those tests; six checks pass on Windows.
A page saved with Windows line endings keeps its review stamp.
The stamp hashed the page as read, so CRLF made a reviewed plan page look stale and refused the plan half of a combined approval.
The hash treats CRLF and LF alike.

unverified: Nine other checks still fail on Windows only (guard cwd, a delete under the temp folder, waitfor, two page checks, one node check); they were not investigated and sit outside this feature
The full verify.py was not rerun after the stamp fix; only the acceptance criteria were
The deviation check is a phrase heuristic and has not been seen firing in a live session
No test covers the two-round cap, re-review of changed picks, or page-mode and plan-mode checks separately
Round 1 was written into ledger form afterwards from report.md, not from a fresh run

wrapup.summary: The design review loop passes its acceptance run on your PC and waits for your QA.
wrapup.changing: checks/design_loop.py, scripts/page_criteria.py, the changelog, round records and the acceptance stamp under docs/qa/design-review-loop.
wrapup.next: On a pass, the pull request for #592 is ready to merge. On a fail, I fix it on this branch.
